_comment: This file is loaded with Godot's JSON.parse_string (see curse_data.gd), which is STRICT JSON - it has no // or /* */ comments. Adding real comments will fail to parse and silently empty out EVERY curse in the game. Use '_comment_<field>' sibling keys like the ones below instead - the loader only reads specific named keys, so extra '_'-prefixed keys are safely ignored.

config._comment_tier_min_floor: Room depth (NOT map tier) at/above which curses can appear at all, indexed by CURRENT MAP TIER (index 0/1/2 = Tier 0/Tier 1/Tier 2). Below this depth, no curses ever spawn - should_curse() is always false and get_min_curse_count() is always 0. Lower value = curses start earlier. Tiers past index 2 use index 2 as their base, then infinite_mode.min_floor_decrement_per_tier below lowers it further.
config._comment_curse_chance: Base per-enemy probability (0-1) of getting a random bonus curse on top of the guaranteed count below. Multiplied by difficulty_chance_mult and tier_curse_chance_mult, then by infinite_mode's increment past base_tier.
config._comment_difficulty_chance_mult: Multiplies curse_chance by the player's chosen difficulty.
config._comment_tier_curse_chance_mult: Multiplies curse_chance by the CURRENT MAP TIER (index 0/1/2 = Tier 0/Tier 1/Tier 2 - the 3 classic maps, NOT room depth). Tiers past index 2 reuse the last entry as their base, then infinite_mode below adds extra growth on top.
config._comment_min_curse_count_per_room: How many extra GUARANTEED cursed enemies each room depth past min_floor adds, on a normal (non-boss) battle.
config._comment_boss_curse_count: Fixed guaranteed cursed-enemy count for the tier's FINAL BOSS battle only. Replaces the min_curse_count_per_room formula entirely for that one fight (ignores room depth/min_floor).
config._comment_mini_boss_curse_count: Same idea as boss_curse_count, but for the mid-map MINI-BOSS battle (the queen encounter on Tier 1/Tier 2).

infinite_mode._comment_base_tier: Last map tier MapGenerator.TIER_CONFIGS actually defines. Infinite mode keeps incrementing the tier number forever, but the map itself just repeats Tier 2's layout past this point - so everything below adds scaling that keeps climbing where the map layout itself no longer does.
infinite_mode._comment_curse_count_per_tier_and_max: Extra guaranteed cursed enemies added per map tier ABOVE base_tier, clamped at max_curse_count total (set max_curse_count to -1 to remove the clamp).
infinite_mode._comment_min_floor_decrement_and_clamp: Lowers the effective tier_min_floor by this much per map tier ABOVE base_tier, so curses keep starting earlier the deeper an infinite run goes - clamped so it never drops below min_floor_clamp (0 = curses can appear from the very first room).
infinite_mode._comment_curse_chance_increment_and_max: Extra flat probability added to curse_chance per map tier ABOVE base_tier, clamped at max_curse_chance (0-1).

config._example_infinite_mode_tier_3_room_depth: Worked example with the defaults above, difficulty=normal, at map tier 3 (1 tier past base_tier=2) and room depth 4: effective min_floor = tier_min_floor[index 2, since tier 3 is past the array's last index 2] = 2, minus (3-2)*min_floor_decrement_per_tier[1] = 1 (would clamp at min_floor_clamp=0 if it went further negative) - so this run's curses already start at room depth 1, instead of Tier 0's depth 4. GUARANTEED count = (4-1+1)*min_curse_count_per_room[1] + (3-2)*curse_count_per_tier[1] = 4 + 1 = 5 cursed enemies (under max_curse_count=8, so no clamp yet). BONUS chance per remaining enemy = curse_chance[0.25] * difficulty_chance_mult.normal[1.0] * tier_curse_chance_mult[index 2 = 1.5] + (3-2)*curse_chance_increment_per_tier[0.05] = 0.375 + 0.05 = 0.425 (42.5%) per non-guaranteed enemy.

snowfall.name: Snowfall
snowfall.description: Covers a + area in decaying snow after it moves.

stunning_gaze.name: Stunning Gaze
stunning_gaze.description: After it moves, stuns the closest ally in its sight for 1 turn.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: Covers a 3x3 area in slow-decaying snow after it moves. The enemy king's own curse.

fey_step.name: Fey Step
fey_step.description: Cannot capture. After moving, may blink to a random open tile nearby.

changeling.name: Changeling
changeling.description: After moving, swaps places with its closest fellow enemy.

abduction.name: Abduction
abduction.description: After moving, swaps places with the closest ally in its sight.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: After it moves, roots the closest ally in its sight for 1 turn - they can still capture, but can't move to open ground.

wraith_cloak.name: Wraith Cloak
wraith_cloak.description: Starts hidden in its own snow until it first moves.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: Covers a + area in snow after it moves, which can spread to neighboring tiles if left alone.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: After a capture, immediately acts again (up to a limit).
